page: Amazon Web Services c8id.32xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it features 128 vCPUs across 64 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The CPU configuration includes a 480 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX). The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of DDR5 memory running at 7 GHz, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

This instance incorporates 7600 GB of local NVMe SSD storage as instance store volumes, providing high-capacity local storage. It operates on the AWS Nitro hypervisor and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps. No dedicated GPUs are included in this hardware profile.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in multi-core CPU execution, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and software compilation. Memory bandwidth tests show top-tier read speeds for both small and large blocks, alongside strong write performance. In database operations, the instance achieves top-tier results, including high Redis SET throughput and static web serving capacity. LLM inference benchmarks show top-tier prompt processing across small, medium, and large models, though text generation speeds vary from average to strong depending on model size. The hardware profile and benchmark results make this instance suitable for compute-heavy workloads, database operations, software compilation, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
